title: My pipes
intro: Every pipe has a story. Keep its details, memories and photographs.
emptyText: Add your first pipe to start your catalogue.
footnote: Functional prototype V1 · Data is stored only in this browser. Cloud storage is not available yet: do not use this version as your only archive for important data. You can export and import a JSON backup.
choosePhoto: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo (max 3 MB)
deleteConfirm: Permanently delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.
importConfirm: Import {{count}} pipes? Your current collection will be replaced.
recoveryConfirm: The current data cannot be read. Download the original data first to preserve it. Replace it with this backup?
photoInvalid: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP file up to 3 MB.
storageRead: Unable to read stored data. The original data has not been changed. Download it for recovery or import a valid backup.
storageWrite: Unable to save. Browser storage may be full: export your data and try smaller photos.
importError: Import failed: invalid format or data (maximum 20 MB, no duplicate IDs).
rawError: Unable to access the original browser data.
soonText: This module will be available in a future milestone.

auth.localNotice: Your pipe collection and photographs stay in this browser. Signing in or out does not transfer, replace or separate local collections by account. On a shared device, local data remains visible after logout.
auth.unavailable: Account access is not configured. You can continue using your local catalogue.
auth.badConfig: Account configuration is invalid. Contact the site administrator; your local catalogue remains available.
auth.confirmed: Email confirmed. You are signed in.
auth.checkEmail: Check your inbox for the confirmation link. If your address is already registered, try signing in or recovering your password. Open the link in the same browser and on the same site where you registered.
auth.resetSent: If the address is registered, you will receive a recovery email. Open the link in the same browser and on the same site where you requested it.
auth.sessionEnded: You are signed out. Sign in again to access your account.
auth.passwordHelp: Use at least 12 characters. Do not reuse passwords from other sites.

errors.unconfirmed: Confirm your email before signing in. Check your inbox and spam folder.
errors.password: Use a password of at least 12 characters that meets the security requirements.
errors.samePassword: Choose a different password from the current one.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.callback: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Use the same browser and site where you requested it. Request a new recovery email or try signing in after confirmation.
errors.generic: Unable to complete the operation. Check your connection and try again. If you already have an account, try signing in or recovering your password.
errors.session: Unable to restore access. Check your connection and retry.
errors.profile: You are signed in, but your profile could not be prepared. Retry; your local data has not changed.
